name: okf-loop
description: Runs openknowledge/INDEX.md: the AI-Native SDLC as a live, customizable, semi-autonomous loop with gates, guards and an audit trail.

mode.title: Autonomy mode
mode.description: How much the loop does on its own. 'config' keeps whatever .okf/config.json (or /sdlc mode) says; manual only guards and records, guided proposes the next step, semi chains every non-human step and stops at each human gate.

maxAutoTurns.title: Autopilot turn budget
maxAutoTurns.description: Agent turns the autopilot may queue between two human gates. 0 keeps autonomy.maxAutoTurns from .okf/config.json.

openPaneOnStart.title: Open the Loop pane at session start
openPaneOnStart.description: 'config' keeps ui.openPaneOnStart from .okf/config.json; yes or no overrides it.
